name: Storm Elemental

actions.name: Thunder Slam
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be pushed 6m and deafened for 1 round.

actions.name: Lightning Bolt
actions.effect: Ranged magical attack. Hits all creatures in a 30m line. PHYS save for half.

actions.name: Tempest
actions.effect: Creates a storm in a 12m radius. All creatures must pass PHYS save or take full damage, be knocked prone, and have their movement halved next turn. On success, take half damage only.

reactions.name: Storm Surge
reactions.effect: When hit by a ranged attack, the elemental redirects the projectile with wind. The attack is reflected back at the attacker using the elemental's attack roll.

reactions.name: Thunder Rebuke
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack, the attacker is struck by a thunderclap and must pass PHYS save or be pushed 6m and stunned until end of their next turn.

traits.name: Stormborn
traits.desc: Can fly. Immune to being knocked prone. The elemental is surrounded by constant winds; ranged attacks against it have -1d6.

traits.name: Lightning Rod
traits.desc: Lightning damage dealt to the Storm Elemental instead heals it for the same amount.

lore: Storm Elementals are cataclysmic beings formed when air, water, and lightning fuse into a single entity. They are living thunderstorms, bringing devastation wherever they roam. The crash of their thunder can be heard for miles.
